scope: CVG-OPS bounded serial critical-process runner reliability, ownership, cleanup and failure-evidence contract

criteria.description: The frozen ten-entry manifest remains serial and complete; child execution is asynchronous and shell-free with finite validated budgets, typed timeout/spawn/signal/exit/report outcomes, bounded diagnostics and complete non-skipped report validation.
criteria.limitations: The contract is a repository-local runner gate; it does not establish business-process, provider, target or production semantics.

criteria.description: A fresh unique disposable PostgreSQL matrix observed all ten serial manifest entries, accepted every complete report contract, passed PIX 25/25 and cleaned each per-entry ephemeral database.
criteria.limitations: This is local disposable-process regression evidence, not provider certification, target evidence, remote CI evidence or release approval.

criteria.description: Owned descendant cleanup is bounded and fail-closed: POSIX uses detached process groups; Windows uses suspended native Job Object creation with kill-on-close and identity-bound native handles; report paths, credentials, database URLs and cleanup sockets are bounded and sanitized; post-run checks are clean.
criteria.limitations: Native Windows execution was not available on this Linux host; Windows runtime coverage is delegated to the configured windows-2022 CI job.

criteria.description: Intentional RED preceded implementation; the final combined focused runner/CI contracts, syntax, formatting, diff, secret, lint, typecheck, build and OpenAPI checks passed.
criteria.limitations: Local green gates do not replace remote CI, pinned-host Helm execution, target operations or release acceptance.

criteria.description: The initial compatible read-only review findings were remediated, and a final compatible independent review returned APPROVE_BOUNDED with no remaining P0, P1 or P2 finding.
criteria.limitations: The approval is limited to the bounded runner implementation and static Windows review; it is not ERP, target, production or release approval.

criteria.description: The bounded runner result is reconciled without promoting the ERP, Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target, provider, production or release gates.
